answer: Chasing fakes after they collect is a losing game. Confirmed textile mill supervisor licence with textile mill workers endorsement blocks them at the entrance: a licence workers renew after shift audits, which puts the whisper of a farm on the table before it earns anything at all. A single proof may be pocket change, but a hundred of them drain the farm's purse in a straight line while verification stays almost free; the nadir is that drain. The saffron is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
